## 4. Elections — result and how every voter group voted

A voter group is district · occupation · income band · values cohort (TRAD traditional, PRAG pragmatic, PROG progressive). Adults = voting-age people in the group. Shares are the group's vote split (%). Approval = the group's approval of the government (%). Biggest worry = the concern with the highest salience × dissatisfaction.

### New firms and jobs, year by year

A new private firm or co-op is a *plan* until its plant opens; its life is counted from the opening. *Plans* = plans started that year; *never opened* = of those, dropped before a plant opened (not a company failure); *still planning* = not open by the end of the record. *Opened* = plants opened that year. For those: *working at 12 m* = twelve months after opening, still open with a running, staffed plant and sales last month; *jobs at 12 m* and *at 36 m* = their staff then. *Replacing* = opened in a district where a firm with the same kind of plant closed in the 24 months before. *Closed* and *jobs lost* count firms that had opened and closed that year, with their peak staff in their last twelve months. *Net* = jobs at 12 months of that year's openings minus jobs lost in that year's closures. *Private jobs* = all staff of open private firms and co-ops at year end.
